markdown_content: # New Seam Taping Updates | Clo Feature Deep Dive This document details recent updates and functionalities for seam taping within Clo, focusing on the seam taping tool, its interface elements, and options for extending seam tape edges. It covers technical instructions for using the tool and adjustments available both in the seam taping tool and the edit pattern tool. --- ## Overview of the Seam Taping Tool in Clo This section introduces the seam taping tool found in the 2D toolbar of Clo, designed for both beginners and experienced users to manage seam taping more intuitively. - **Location:** 2D toolbar in Clo. - **Purpose:** Facilitates visual management and editing of seam taping on pattern outlines. - **Features:** - Color-coded seam taping segments for easy differentiation. - Directional arrows indicating start and end points of seam taping. - User-friendly interface aimed at those new to Clo or seam taping. The tool visually breaks down seam taping on pattern pieces, making it simple to identify and modify seam taping directions and lengths. --- ## Extending Seam Taping to Pattern Edges This section explains how to adjust seam taping lengths so they extend properly to the edges of pattern outlines, preventing abrupt stops. - **Common Issue:** Seam taping sometimes stops abruptly before reaching the pattern edge. - **Solution: Using the Extend Option** - Select the **pattern outline** in the 2D window. - Access **Seam Taping** settings in the property editor. - Adjust the **width** of the seam taping (default is 10, adjustable up to any desired value, e.g., 25). - Use the **Extend** dropdown to extend seam taping to desired points. ### Extend Options and Directional Arrows - Arrows on seam taping indicate the direction: - **Arrow pointing outward**: end point. - **Arrow pointing inward**: start point. - You can extend seam taping to: - **Outline:** Extends seam taping to the pattern edge. - **Seam Taping:** Stops extension at the edge of another seam taping to avoid overlap. ### Example Workflow - Select the seam taping segment. - Identify if you are editing the start or end point by the arrow direction. - Choose **Extend to Outline** to make seam taping reach the edge. - Alternatively, choose **Extend to Seam Taping** to stop precisely at the next seam tape edge, preventing overlap. - Overlapping seam taping is generally discouraged as it leads to excessive thickness and reduced flexibility. **Note:** The "Extend to Seam Taping" option only works if the seam taping you are extending towards already reaches the pattern outline edge. --- ## Seam Taping Adjustments in Edit Pattern Tool This section covers how seam taping extensions and adjustments can also be made without using the seam taping tool, directly from the Edit Pattern tool. - When in the **Edit Pattern** mode: - Seam taping is still visible on pattern outlines. - Selecting the pattern edge allows access to seam taping options in the property editor. - You can apply extensions: - From **start to outline** - From **end to outline** - Or disable extensions by selecting **none** This flexibility allows users familiar with Clo to make precise seam taping adjustments without switching tools. --- ## Summary of Key Functionalities - Seam taping tool provides intuitive visual and directional cues for seam taping editing. - Width of seam taping is adjustable. - Extend options allow precise control over seam taping length: - Extend to pattern outline edge. - Extend to adjacent seam taping edge (to avoid overlap). - Seam taping can be adjusted both in the seam taping tool and the edit pattern tool. - Overlapping seam taping is generally avoided to maintain garment flexibility. --- This update enhances seam taping workflow in Clo, offering users better control, visual clarity, and flexibility in pattern edge finishing.
